name: Jennifer Hayes
bio:
Jennifer's motorsport journey began with a fascination for fluid dynamics, sparked by her dad's work at a local aerospace firm. She pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering at MIT and secured an internship with a NASCAR team, where she quickly learned the ropes of race engineering. Her meticulous approach and data analysis skills led her to Formula 1, where she now thrives as a performance engineer.

At Stake Sauber, Jennifer focuses on optimizing car setup and tire management. She prides herself on her ability to translate complex data into actionable insights for the drivers and the wider engineering team. Known for her collaborative spirit and sharp problem-solving skills, she's a valuable asset in the relentless pursuit of performance gains.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, often pulled back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Jennifer has a focused gaze and a no-nonsense demeanor, reflecting her dedication to her work.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even in meetings.
Has a habit of tapping her pen on the table when deep in thought.
Drinks black coffee exclusively, regardless of the time of day.
